title: finding(plugin-detail,tests): RelatedList.unmaterializedSort "keeps that button in client mode" races the object-schema load and ejected PR objectui#10884 from the merge queue
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a flaky test with a named site and a deterministic reproduction. `reach:` the merge queue, measured: it ejected PR objectui#10884 at 2026-09-28T03:16Z. Reader: triage first (route and grade). ⛔ Not graded here.

Filed by objectui's `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`). This seat landed the change that exposed the race (PR objectui#10839, objectui#10728), and whoever finds a flake fixes it or files it. Dedupe: the open issues were grepped for `unmaterializedSort`, `settleObjectSchema` and RelatedList flake/race, with no hit.

## What failed

On the merge-queue commit `cc7098f9b` (`origin/main` `b2683a2` plus PR objectui#10884), `Test (shard 7/8)` failed:

`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.unmaterializedSort.test.tsx` › "RelatedList — the sort-button row for a `list` card (#3950)" › "keeps that button in client mode" (line 222):

`TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an accessible element with the role "button" and name /Total/`

The only buttons present were "Previous" and "Next".

PR objectui#10884 does not touch plugin-detail, and `packages/plugin-detail/src` has 0 references to `plugin-view` or `normalizeListViewSchema`. The file passed 12 of 12 runs on the merge, on the exact queue tree, on plain `main` and on the PR head.

## Mechanism (measured)

Since `184cfe1` (objectui#10728, PR objectui#10839), RelatedList's sort-button row skips every field that is not in `unmaskedColumnKeys`. Every column carries the masked stamp while `objectTypesPending` holds, that is, until `getObjectSchema` resolves. So in client mode the `Total` button exists only after the object-schema chain has committed.

The case gates only on `h.schema?.type === 'data-list'`, which client mode satisfies on the first commit, and then calls `getByRole` synchronously. Whether the schema commit has landed by then depends on scheduling. That is the #7007 trap the same file's docblock describes, and the sibling windowed case is already protected by `settleObjectSchema`.

Scratch probes on `origin/main` `4f38f39`, run by the objectui#10758 dev, not committed:
- **A:** `getObjectSchema` delayed by 50 ms. Exit 1: `1 failed | 4 passed`, the exact CI signature. The windowed case, which has the gate, stayed green.
- **B:** the same delay plus `await settleObjectSchema(dataSource)` in the client-mode case. Exit 0, `5 passed`.
- **C:** the gate alone, no delay. Exit 0, `5 passed`: the gate changes nothing on the normal path.

## The fix (a ready patch)

In that case, change `renderList({ type: 'list', data: items });` to `const dataSource = renderList({ type: 'list', data: items });`. After the `data-list` `waitFor`, insert `await settleObjectSchema(dataSource);`, with a one-line comment: since objectui#10728 the sort-button row reads the masked stamp, which covers every column until the object schema lands (#7007). Probes B and C are the proof.

Also census the other RelatedList tests written before objectui#10728 that assert client-mode sort or filter controls without a schema gate; they may share the race.

## Re-check

- `git -C objectui grep -n "keeps that button in client mode" origin/main -- packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.unmaterializedSort.test.tsx`, then read the case for a `settleObjectSchema` call: none today.
